versions.name: v0-baseline
versions.description: Frozen FIFO singleton baseline before scoring optimizations.

versions.name: v1-multi-active
versions.description: Multiple unfinished singleton requests per cloud with round-robin assignment.

versions.name: v2-load-aware
versions.description: Adds cloud assignment using busy time, known prefill work, ready decode work, and an active-request proxy.

versions.name: v3-immediate-groups
versions.description: Adds immediate grouping for ready D PRE, same-cloud D PROC, and D POST work.

versions.name: v4-table-groups
versions.description: Selects decode group size by interpolated task-table service rate instead of always taking every ready member.

versions.name: v5-slo-aware
versions.description: Adds conservative SLO urgency and tightly gated controlled waiting when future events are known.

versions.name: v6-prefill-chunks
versions.description: Adds adaptive gap-free P PROC layer chunks when longer prefills compete with other cloud work.

versions.name: v7-link-aware
versions.description: Adds transfer-aware group cost and latency-weighted shortest-prefill ordering while preserving FIFO on throughput-weighted links.

versions.name: v8-exact-timelines
versions.description: Tracks exact virtual resource and FIFO-link finish times and bounds batching waits by the next known event.

versions.name: v9-fanout-cohorts
versions.description: Adds cloud-fanout-aware D PRE group formation and waits only for compatible decode cohort events.

versions.name: v10-batch-placement
versions.description: Adds conservative pack-versus-spread cloud placement using future same-cloud decode batching affinity.

versions.name: v11-score-slack
versions.description: Ranks predicted-overdue work by marginal milestone progress using TDR and next-token path slack.

versions.name: v12-deadline-chunks
versions.description: Sizes prefill chunks around the next compatible decode event or TPOT deadline instead of a fixed target alone.

versions.name: v13-attained-service
versions.description: Adds least-attained-service decode selection with aging and an online completed-output survival estimate.

versions.name: v14-backpressure
versions.description: Adds downstream UP/DOWN pressure penalties so congested stages favor draining work over injecting more transfers.

versions.name: v15-one-token-lookahead
versions.description: Adds bounded rolling one-token lookahead when a locally efficient group is hostile to the downstream decode path.

versions.name: v16-counterfactual-groups
versions.description: Enumerates bounded membership and size candidates for all decode stages, predicts their next-token path on virtual queues, and deviates from the v15 fallback only above a safety margin.

versions.name: v17-learned-group-ranker
versions.description: Uses offline-fitted linear action-value coefficients selected on deterministic generated training workloads with a separate holdout audit.

versions.name: v18-nonlinear-group-ranker
versions.description: Adds optional nonlinear feature interactions; the exported search selected zero interaction weights, so this layer records a rejected-complexity result rather than an unsupported promotion.

versions.name: v19-terminal-dpost
versions.description: Starts again from the promoted v15 lineage and only enlarges terminal D POST groups when bounded full-queue simulation predicts at least a two-percent clearance improvement without sacrificing the score surrogate.

versions.name: v20-terminal-dproc
versions.description: Extends v19 with a one-cloud, throughput-dominant D PROC to FIFO DOWN to D POST clearance rollout and retains the v19 choice outside its fully modeled regime.

versions.name: v84-exact-dpost-partition
versions.description: Experimental whole-ready-queue D POST partition dynamic program, guarded by the existing terminal score and clearance rollout; retained for its broad-corpus regression evidence rather than promoted.

versions.name: v85-censored-completion-index
versions.description: Experimental right-censored token-age hazard and Gittins-style completion index with a 64-exposure gate; retained after neutral validation and mixed training evidence.

versions.name: v86-objective-margin-rollout
versions.description: Rejected broad three-action resource-sequence rollout using public service tables and predicted SLO margins.

versions.name: v87-guarded-margin-rollout
versions.description: Latency-dominant, overdue-only guard around v86; still retained as rejected because the frozen suite exposed four losses.

versions.name: v88-robust-portfolio-policy
versions.description: Rejected quantized 18-to-8-to-6 residual coherent-DPOST selector trained on lower-confidence targets grouped by identical public states across hidden-output worlds; its frozen 0.50-margin independent holdout produced 24 wins and one loss.

versions.name: working-tree
versions.description: Current v83 submission adds a quantized conservative neural coherent-DPOST selector to the v69 sparse initial-decode barrier and the earlier audited layer-20 guards.
